# stacklet_iac_project (Resource)

Manage an IaC project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stacklet_iac_policy_collection" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "stacklet_iac_project" "example" {
  name = "example"
  collections = [
    stacklet_iac_policy_collection.example.name,
  ]
  read_groups = [
    "developers",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the project.

### Optional

- `collections` (Set of String) The names of the policy collections used by the project.
- `read_groups` (Set of String) The names of the groups with read access to the project.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client ID of the project credentials, if any.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stacklet_iac_project.example
  id = "$name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stacklet_iac_project.example $name
```
